Container.Name: MVidarr
Container.Overview:
MVidarr is a self-hosted music video collection manager and player designed for home users. Organize, discover, and play your music video library with automated metadata enrichment, playlist management, and a modern web interface.
✨ Optimized for Unraid 7.2.0+ ✨
Features: - Automatic metadata enrichment from IMVDb and YouTube - Smart playlist generation and management - Thumbnail generation and artist artwork - Modern, responsive web interface - FastAPI backend with WebSocket support - Full subtitle support for music videos - MKV video transcoding for browser playback - Celery task queue for background processing (Redis-powered) - Theme customization support - Container health monitoring - Automatic job queue management
Requirements: - Unraid 7.2.0 or higher - MariaDB 11.4+ or MySQL 8.0+ (install from Community Apps) - Redis 7+ cache/job queue (install from Community Apps) - FFmpeg (included in container) - yt-dlp (included in container)
Container.Description: Complete music video collection management system with automated metadata, transcoding, and modern web interface. Requires MariaDB and Redis containers.
Container.Requires: MariaDB 11.4+ or MySQL 8.0+ database (install from Community Apps) AND Redis 7+ cache/queue (install from Community Apps)

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port - access MVidarr at http://[UNRAID-IP]:[PORT]

Config.Name: Music Videos
Config.Description: Path to your music video files (can be on array or cache)

Config.Name: Thumbnails
Config.Description: Thumbnail and artwork storage (recommended: cache drive for performance)

Config.Name: Database Folder
Config.Description: Application database files (SQLite fallback - recommended: cache drive)

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: Application log files (recommended: cache drive)

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Temporary download storage for yt-dlp (recommended: cache drive for speed)

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Application cache storage (recommended: cache drive)

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Application configuration files (recommended: cache drive)

Config.Name: DB_HOST
Config.Description: Database hostname - use the exact container name of your MariaDB container (case-sensitive)

Config.Name: DB_PORT
Config.Description: Database port (default MySQL/MariaDB port is 3306)

Config.Name: DB_USER
Config.Description: Database username - must match the user created in MariaDB

Config.Name: DB_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Database password - MUST match your MariaDB user password exactly

Config.Name: DB_NAME
Config.Description: Database name - must match the database created in MariaDB

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Secret key for session encryption - generate with: openssl rand -base64 32 (minimum 32 characters)

Config.Name: MVIDARR_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: MVidarr secret key - should match SECRET_KEY for consistency

Config.Name: IMVDB_API_KEY
Config.Description: IMVDb API key for music video metadata enrichment - get free key at https://imvdb.com/developers

Config.Name: YOUTUBE_API_KEY
Config.Description: YouTube Data API v3 key for metadata enrichment - get from Google Cloud Console

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for logs and scheduled tasks (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions - Unraid default is 99 (nobody). Run 'id username' to find yours

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions - Unraid default is 100 (users). Run 'id username' to find yours

Config.Name: DEBUG
Config.Description: Enable debug mode for verbose logging (true/false) - only enable for troubleshooting

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal application port - should match WebUI Port setting above

Config.Name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
Config.Description: Python unbuffered output for real-time logging in Docker logs

Config.Name: REDIS_HOST
Config.Description: Redis hostname - use the exact container name of your Redis container (case-sensitive)

Config.Name: REDIS_PORT
Config.Description: Redis port (default Redis port is 6379)

Config.Name: REDIS_URL
Config.Description: Redis connection URL - auto-configured from REDIS_HOST:REDIS_PORT/database

Config.Name: CELERY_BROKER_URL
Config.Description: Celery message broker URL - uses Redis database 0 for job queuing

Config.Name: CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND
Config.Description: Celery result backend URL - uses Redis database 1 for job results storage

Config.Name: BACKGROUND_JOBS_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable background job processing for metadata enrichment, thumbnails, etc.

Config.Name: JOB_SYSTEM_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable Celery job system for asynchronous task processing

Config.Name: JOB_WORKER_COUNT
Config.Description: Number of Celery worker processes - increase for faster parallel processing (recommended: 2-6)
